automationNotes: Not doc-derived — no published "delete a Launch project" doc exists. Explicit QA test-hygiene cleanup requested by the user: after quick-start-gatsby creates a project, delete it so the org does not accumulate leftover Launch projects. Matches the project card by the exact name quick-start-gatsby used ("Gatsby Starter {unique5}") — the {unique5} token is shared with the sibling quick-start-gatsby run via core/executor.ts uniqueForFlow() (falls back to the first listed project card, with a warning, if run standalone). Steps: open project card -> Settings (top nav) -> scroll to Delete Project section -> Delete Project button -> confirm modal (type DELETE, click Yes, Delete). Handlers: rules/core/actionRules.ts (delete-quick-start-*-project).
